videos.script: Detecting something and preventing it are the same watch, set to two different strengths. {{dial}} An alert that is wrong costs somebody a minute. A block that is wrong locks out the director on the morning of the audit. {{f2b}} So this lesson puts one of each on the portal. fail2ban counts failed logins, and bans the address that keeps failing. You fail on purpose, from your own workstation, and watch the ban land in the firewall. {{aide}} AIDE records how the important files looked on the day somebody approved them, and reports every change since. {{mac}} Then the strongest kind of prevention, which confines a program to what it may touch. {{tune}} And the numbers that decide whether any of it stays switched on.
